svg.title: Top-view beam spread — InnoCart 38×32 cm cavity
svg.desc: Top-down view of the cart floor showing beam cones from ANT1 (left), ANT2 (right), ANT4 (front), and ANT3 (floor centre). Beam half-angle 53°.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about ANT1 left wall beam coverage')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about ANT2 right wall beam coverage')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about ANT4 front wall beam coverage')
sendPrompt('Tell me more about ANT3 floor beam coverage')

svg.text: back wall (no antenna — covered by ANT4 overshoot)
ANT1 + ANT2 beam cones (left/right walls, 53° half-angle, fires across 38 cm depth)
ANT4 beam cone (front wall, 53° half-angle, fires across 32 cm depth)
ANT3 beam rings (floor, circular spread, covers full area above H=14.3 cm)
Multi-antenna overlap zone — highest field density, all 4 beams converge
